note: Replies the judge must mark correctly. 'want' is the correct mark: right passes the quiz, wrong fails it.

cases.label: plain
cases.reply: Partial revert. Some calls in the batch reverted while others went through, so part of the batch's changes may be onchain.

cases.label: partly, no keyword
cases.reply: The batch was only partly successful: it landed onchain, but at least one call reverted while other calls' changes stuck.

cases.label: echoes the question
cases.reply: Status 600 means the batch was partially executed onchain. Some calls succeeded and others reverted.

cases.label: mixed outcome
cases.reply: Mixed outcome. The batch reached the chain, but some calls failed while others succeeded, so check each receipt.

cases.label: EIP's own name
cases.reply: Partial chain rules failure. The batch reverted partially, and some calls' changes may already be onchain.

cases.label: full revert, which is 500
cases.reply: Complete revert. Every call in the batch reverted, and only the gas was charged onchain.

cases.label: hedged both ways
cases.reply: Either a partial or a full revert. The wallet uses 600 whenever the batch failed onchain, whether some or all calls reverted.

cases.label: user rejected
cases.reply: User rejected. The user declined the batch in the wallet, so nothing was sent onchain.

cases.label: offchain failure that mentions partial
cases.reply: Offchain failure. The wallet couldn't submit the batch, though some calls may have partially gone through.

cases.label: pending that mentions partial
cases.reply: Pending. The batch is partially processed and still waiting for confirmation.

cases.label: the oracle's reply
cases.reply: Partial onchain revert. Some calls reverted while others succeeded, so some changes can remain onchain.

cases.label: names 500 to set it apart
cases.reply: Partial revert. Unlike status 500, where the whole batch reverted, 600 means some calls reverted while others' changes may be onchain.

cases.label: partial, meaning partly pending
cases.reply: Partially confirmed. Some calls in the batch have been included onchain and the rest are still waiting to execute.
